database_description: The university database is designed to manage and track students, courses, enrollments, and faculty information.

tables.name: students
tables.description: Table containing personal details of students enrolled in the university.

columns.name: student_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for a student.

columns.name: username
columns.description: The unique login name for a student.

columns.name: email
columns.description: The student's email address.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The student's first name.

columns.name: surname
columns.description: The student's surname.

columns.name: date_of_birth
columns.description: The student's date of birth.

tables.name: courses
tables.description: Table containing information about courses offered by the university.

columns.name: course_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for a course.

columns.name: title
columns.description: The title of the course.

columns.name: description
columns.description: A brief description of the course.

columns.name: credits
columns.description: The number of credits awarded for completing the course.

tables.name: faculty
tables.description: Table containing information about faculty members who teach courses.

columns.name: faculty_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for a faculty member.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The faculty member's first name.

columns.name: surname
columns.description: The faculty member's surname.

columns.name: email
columns.description: The faculty member's email address.

columns.name: department
columns.description: The department to which the faculty member belongs.

tables.name: enrollments
tables.description: Table containing information about students enrolled in courses.

columns.name: enrollment_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for an enrollment record.

columns.name: student_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the student enrolled in the course.

columns.name: course_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the course in which the student is enrolled.

columns.name: enrollment_date
columns.description: The date when the student enrolled in the course.

tables.name: teaching_assignments
tables.description: Table containing information about faculty members assigned to teach courses.

columns.name: assignment_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for a teaching assignment.

columns.name: faculty_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the faculty member assigned to teach the course.

columns.name: course_id
columns.description: Foreign key referencing the course being taught.

columns.name: semester
columns.description: The semester during which the course is taught.
